verdict.rationale: LightSprint's own docs say every task runs in its own isolated sandbox full-stack environment, which cloud agents work inside. Admins can control and monitor which external services agents reach from those sandboxes, and an onboarding agent sets up the environment and setup script. missing for 10: explicit documentation that agents install dependencies at runtime inside the sandbox, technical detail on the isolation mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent safely execute code and install dependencies inside an isolated sandbox

citations.quote: every task on your board its own full-stack environment: an isolated sandbox with a branched database when needed
Control and monitor which external services coding agents can reach from their isolated sandboxes.
LightSprint's onboarding agent will set up your codebase, environment variables and setup script automatically.
Open a live preview for any task in progress without affecting production.
